_note: Custom mapping of techs to a category by an LLM, for techs that no provider categorised anywhere in the panel. Without it, a provider's unconfirmed claims of such techs would carry no bucket and silently drop out of its per-category precision. Lowest precedence: tech_overrides in category_crosswalk.json, then the company's own provider vote, then the panel-wide vote, then this file.
